The modern Mandarin reading pair is recorded in local Unihan data and does not establish the historical phonetic relationship; the Old Chinese reconstructions are secondary table evidence, not direct ancient pronunciations.
巴 gives 吧 its sound cue; their Mandarin readings bā and ba are similar, and historical reconstructions also show a correspondence.
